meta.title: Tap & Build: idle factory game for Android
meta.description: Tap, build and automate your factory. A free idle factory game for Android with offline progress, prestige and a market where you invest in other players.

title: Tap.
Build.
Unwind.
hero.lead: You start with one conveyor belt and end up with a factory that never sleeps. Free, no sign-up, and it keeps producing while you're away.

tabs.label: Tap and produce
tabs.caption: Every tap speeds the line up. When you're done tapping, managers take over.

tabs.label: Buy machines
tabs.caption: You buy machines, level them up, and they produce on their own.

tabs.label: Reset and ascend
tabs.caption: Start over with permanent multipliers that never go away.

tabs.label: Invest in players
tabs.caption: You buy shares in real factories and get paid when they produce.

steps.title: How it plays
steps.lead: Three things, in this order. After that it runs itself.

items.title: Tap to start
items.text: The belt produces on every tap. That's the only manual work you'll ever do.

items.title: Automate
items.text: Buy machines and managers. The factory keeps running with the app closed.

items.title: Ascend
items.text: Reset the factory in exchange for permanent multipliers. Every run is faster.

themesSection.title: The same themes as the game
themesSection.lead: The game ships {n} palettes. These eight are the most distinct. Tap one and the whole site changes with it.
themesSection.note: Four are included; the rest unlock with packs or by inviting friends.

finalCta.title: Your factory is waiting
finalCta.text: Free on Android. No sign-up, no endless tutorial.

pressPage.title: Press
pressPage.lead: Everything you need to write about, record or cover Tap & Build. If something's missing, ask: we answer.

different.title: A market between players
different.text: Players buy shares in each other's factories and get paid when they produce. The economy is player-driven, not a bot.

different.title: Grid with synergies
different.text: Machines go on a grid and complete rows give a bonus. It's not just stacking numbers.

different.title: 30 themes
different.text: Every player picks how their factory looks, from 30 palettes.

pressPage.assetsText: Up-to-date screenshots, high-res icon and logo: ask by email and we'll send them the same day. We'd rather send you the latest build than have an old one published.
